root_husk.name: Root-Husk Vagrant

visibleGear.weapon: Calcified splinter claws fused to finger bones
visibleGear.armor: Rotted wool tunic plated with pale bark over the chest
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: A pulsing white spore-sac swells beneath its broken collarbones.

anatomy.faceDetail: Sunken cheeks pull taut over chalk-white teeth, eyes clouded by pale filament.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Split ribs bow outward where white, bell-shaped tendrils thread through torn homespun.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Long, dry forearms terminate in stiffened claws crusted with gray bark.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Shambles forward on uneven, root-stiffened knees that scrape the flagstones.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Faint bronze-like ticking rattles inside its open throat.

root_husk.firstSightProse: Wet gravel crunches in the mist as a stooped human figure lurches out of the reeds. Its skin has turned chalk-grey, white tendrils push through its split wool shirt like pale ribs, and dry fingers harden into splintered bone claws.
root_husk.returnSightProse: A Root-Husk Vagrant staggers out of the gray fog, pale tendrils rattling inside its chest.
root_husk.description: A hollow villager whose ribs burst with pale, bell-like tendrils.

intents.label: Bark-Harden
intents.description: plates its ribs in pale bark.

ash_hound.name: Cinder-Maw Hound

visibleGear.armor: Singed, scarred mastiff hide with no barding
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Glow-cinder glands pulse red along its narrow windpipe before a leap.

anatomy.faceDetail: A narrow mastiff muzzle parts over blackened teeth, trailing thin curls of grey smoke from cracked gums.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Deep, starved ribcage heaves beneath patches of singed fur and blistered ash-hide.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Sinewy forelegs end in split dewclaws blackened from digging through kiln-cinders.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Low, coiled hindquarters shift constantly on the ash, built to spring across ten paces.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Faint orange sparks drift from its nostrils with every panting breath.

ash_hound.firstSightProse: Thin smoke curls low across the damp stones before the beast appears. Out of the haze pads a starved, hound-shaped predator with singed charcoal fur and deep hollow ribs; orange embers glimmer inside its parted jaws as it crouches low to the earth.
ash_hound.returnSightProse: A Cinder-Maw Hound pads low across the ash, smoke trailing from its blackened teeth.
ash_hound.description: Gaunt frontier mastiff whose breath trails grey embers.

intents.label: Ash-Pounce
intents.description: bares ember-lit fangs for a leap.

chitin_weaver.name: Chitin-Weaver

visibleGear.weapon: Serrated ivory mandibles dripping green acid
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Soft pale joints sit exposed underneath the second thoracic seam.

anatomy.faceDetail: Clustered obsidian eyes glint above twin jagged mandibles wet with hissing silk.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Overlapping ivory carapace segments cover a heavy, hunched thorax.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Hooked forelimbs grip stone and web-strands with effortless leverage.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Six jointed legs skitter sideways without sound across damp stone.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Pale silver thread glistens between its rear spinnerets.

chitin_weaver.firstSightProse: Dry clicking echoes from the damp masonry overhead as a pale, six-legged carapace drops onto the flagstones. Clustered black eyes glint above twin serrated mandibles dripping acrid silk across the mossy stone.
chitin_weaver.returnSightProse: A Chitin-Weaver skitters sideways across the stone, mandibles clacking wet with acid.
chitin_weaver.description: Subterranean pale beetle-stalker nesting beneath the Cistern aqueducts.

iron_deserter.name: Levy-Brigand
iron_deserter.interrogateHint: He coughs out that smugglers trade Under-Warren grafts behind Harken at Cinderford, and the Weeping Barrow hides a silver Echo-Shell.

visibleGear.weapon: Notched iron halberd with stained haft
visibleGear.armor: Dented Iron-Vow brigandine and cracked pavise shield
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: His left knee favors an old pike wound whenever he plants his shield.

anatomy.faceDetail: Hollow, jittery eyes peer beneath a dented kettle helm, jaw clenched tight over stained teeth.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Thick shoulders fill out a torn Iron-Vow surcoat with the garrison badge scraped off.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Heavy, calloused forearms work the long iron halberd with practiced militia grip.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Wide infantry stance planted solidly in the rutted mud.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Amber withdrawal tremors twitch faintly in his shield hand.

iron_deserter.firstSightProse: Iron rattles behind a fallen milestone as a stocky soldier steps into the road in a torn surcoat with the garrison crest scraped away. Beneath a dented kettle helm, bloodshot eyes lock onto your purse while thick forearms level a rusted halberd.
iron_deserter.returnSightProse: A Levy-Brigand steps into the ruts, bracing a dented pavise beside a notched halberd.
iron_deserter.description: A deserter from the frontier pike-line, eyes clouded by Vesper-withdrawal.

intents.label: Pommel Smash
intents.description: hefts steel for an overhead blow.

blight_acolyte.name: Choir Acolyte

visibleGear.weapon: Tarnished bronze chain-censer smoking with pale spores
visibleGear.armor: Soot-stiffened penitent robes over chalky ribs
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Thin silver chimes sewn into its cuffs focus every chant.

anatomy.faceDetail: A frayed linen blindfold binds the brow over cracked lips whispering an unbroken cadence.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Narrow, hollow torso sways like a pendulum beneath damp ash-colored vestments.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Bony wrists swing a heavy bronze censer in wide, hypnotic arcs.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Bare, blackened feet glide steadily over wet stones without flinching.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Pale spore smoke trails from beneath its linen hood.

blight_acolyte.firstSightProse: A sweet, copper reek rolls ahead of a tall robed figure gliding down the ridge. Linen binds its blind eyes while bony hands swing a heavy bronze censer that pours choking grey spores across the flagstones.
blight_acolyte.returnSightProse: A Choir Acolyte sways out of the haze, swinging its smoking bronze censer.
blight_acolyte.description: Blind zealot swinging a tarnished censer of pale-root incense.

husk_kale.name: Husk-Stalker Kale

visibleGear.weapon: Broken broadsword fused to forearm bone by white roots
visibleGear.armor: Torn Iron-Vow chainmail knit together with pale tendons
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: A half-calcified leather strap still dangles where you tore his satchel.

anatomy.faceDetail: An unhinged jaw trembles with bronze resonance while familiar haunted eyes stare from chalky sockets.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Rusted mail rings bite into white root-cords binding his ribs tight.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: His right forearm has calcified completely around a jagged broken sword blade.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Hunched, spring-loaded crouch built for desperate lunges out of ditches.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Rusted Iron-Vow chain links still clink against his collar.

husk_kale.firstSightProse: Pale roots drag a familiar torn mail-shirt out of the ditch. Its jaw hangs unhinged, rattling a hollow bronze whine, and a broken broadsword is fused straight into the calcified bone of its right forearm.
husk_kale.returnSightProse: Husk-Stalker Kale drags his root-fused blade across the stones.
husk_kale.description: The deserter you left to turn, his broken sword fused to his bone by pale roots.

intents.label: Root-Snare
intents.description: drives gnarled knuckles into the mud.

star_stag.name: Corrupted Star-Stag

visibleGear.weapon: Towering silver antlers choked in bronze root-chimes
visibleGear.armor: Fossilized white bark plates grown across chest and flanks
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: A silver leaf-blade gleams wedged inside the mossy plinth behind its hooves.

anatomy.faceDetail: A regal silver muzzle drips frosty spore-mist beneath grief-stricken violet eyes.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: A massive barrel chest plates over in chalky wood whenever it braces.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Forelegs forged like living birch strike hard enough to crack stone.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Cloven silver hooves paw sparks out of petrified roots.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Pale bell-vines ring softly from its great crown of antlers.

star_stag.firstSightProse: Petrified ferns snap apart as a towering stag bursts into the glade. Its silver flank is plated in chalky bark, pale vines wind through its immense crown of antlers, and tiny bone-chimes ring with every furious stamp of its hooves.
star_stag.returnSightProse: The Corrupted Star-Stag lowers its chiming rack across the silver clearing.
star_stag.description: An ancient spirit of the Ael-Thalor woods, antlers choked in pale spore-chimes.

intents.label: Antler Charge
intents.description: lowers its chiming rack to charge.

intents.label: Silver Bark
intents.description: hardens its hide into petrified bark.

forge_automaton.name: Basalt Kiln-Warden

visibleGear.armor: Interlocking Durnfolk slate plates and copper steam-shutters
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: A brass pressure pin behind its left shoulder vents all piston force.

anatomy.faceDetail: A carved stone faceplate hides a glowing orange ember slit behind iron grate-bars.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: A riveted furnace core hisses white steam through heavy slate shutters.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Pillar-thick basalt arms pivot on copper gears, right fist forged into a crushing hammer.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Heavy stone feet shake the flooded flagstones with each deliberate step.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Pre-Shattering Durnfolk guild runes glow dull orange across its breastplate.

forge_automaton.firstSightProse: Water ripples across the flooded hall as a towering figure of carved basalt and copper gears lurches upright from the steam. Orange furnace light burns behind its iron visor-slit while a piston-driven stone hammer rises overhead.
forge_automaton.returnSightProse: The Basalt Kiln-Warden grinds forward through knee-deep steam, furnace hammer raised.
forge_automaton.description: A Durnfolk brass-and-slate golem guarding the flooded furnace valve.

sir_vorne.name: Sir Vorne
sir_vorne.interrogateHint: Through his cracked bronze visor he whispers that the Weeping Barrow holds his original oath and the First Kiln ignition cipher.

visibleGear.weapon: Enormous bronze Bell-Cleaver notched from centuries of vigil
visibleGear.armor: Tarnished bronze plate fused at the gorget into a bell-shaped greathelm
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: His old knightly oath is still engraved faintly along the flat of the blade.

anatomy.faceDetail: No flesh shows beneath the cast bronze bell-helm, only deep shadow and a slow hollow breath.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Massive green-tarnished pauldrons and breastplate stand weathered by mountain wind.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Gauntleted hands grip the great cleaver with disciplined, unhurried mastery.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Greaved boots plant like fortress pillars along the broken parapet.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: The mountain gale draws a low, mournful hum from his bronze helm.

sir_vorne.firstSightProse: A towering figure in green-tarnished bronze rises from a stone plinth above the chasm. His gorget has fused seamlessly into a cast bell-shaped greathelm that hums in the mountain wind as gauntleted hands hoist an enormous bronze cleaver.
sir_vorne.returnSightProse: Sir Vorne plants his boots on the shattered parapet, bronze cleaver ringing softly.
sir_vorne.description: A towering knight fused into his bronze-bell helm, keeping hollow watch above the Belfry.

intents.label: Helm Resonance
intents.description: rings his great helm with a gauntlet.

silk_assassin.name: Cistern Vengeance
silk_assassin.interrogateHint: She hisses that the Seal of Silence breaks Malakor's Drowning Toll, though the Matrons will never forgive the drained Font.

visibleGear.weapon: Twin Vesper-glass stilettos and coiled acid wire
visibleGear.armor: Pale luminous spider-silk mantle that blurs outlines in mist
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Every step lands completely silent on silk-wrapped soles.

anatomy.faceDetail: A translucent white silk veil hides eyes and brow, leaving only a calm, unforgiving mouth visible.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Lithe, slender torso drapes in layered pale silk weighted with small silver needles.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Long, steady fingers spin amber-glass blades with effortless precision.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Weightless, crouching balance poised to vanish sideways through fog.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Pale cistern ink spirals up both wrists.

silk_assassin.firstSightProse: A silver wire sings past your ear and snaps taut into a roadside stone. Out of the fog glides a lithe, veiled woman wrapped in luminous white silk, spinning twin amber-glass stilettos without a sound.
silk_assassin.returnSightProse: The Cistern Vengeance circles through the fog, twin amber stilettos gleaming.
silk_assassin.description: A veiled sister of the Silken Cistern dispatched to reclaim stolen Vesper blood.

malakor.name: Malakor, Choir-Husk

visibleGear.armor: Living pale-root vestments and fractured High Warden bell-crown
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Three resonance conduits link his crown to the great upside-down bell overhead.

anatomy.faceDetail: Beneath a cracked bronze bell-crown, an ancient calcified visage gazes down with steady amber sparks in hollow sockets.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: A towering chest woven from old royal vestments and thick, breathing white roots rises from the sunken throne.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Long, pale arms grip a bronze scepter thick as a lance while root-tendrils curl around each wrist.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Root-bound lower limbs anchor directly into the amphitheater dais, dragging free with stone-grinding power.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Every breath draws a deep metallic shudder from the colossal bell suspended overhead.

malakor.firstSightProse: At the center of the drowned amphitheater hangs an upside-down bronze bell vast as a keep. Beneath its silent lip rises a towering crowned figure woven into a throne of living white roots, ancient amber light burning inside hollow eyes as a bronze scepter lifts from the stone.
malakor.returnSightProse: Malakor, the Choir-Husk, rises from his pale-root throne beneath the great drowned bell.
malakor.description: The fallen High Bell-Warden, throne-bound to the Pale Root beneath a cracked bronze spire.

intents.label: Drowning Toll
intents.description: draws breath beneath the great drowned bell.

intents.label: Belfry Aegis
intents.description: summons living bark around his throne.
